PR objectui#11964 (draft, 1 commit `f835af41` whose one parent is the merge base with `main`, `70e3d772`; no merge, no rebase, no force-push; 6 files, +235/−12; head repository = base repository, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, assignee `huangyiirene`, no auto-merge, `mergeable_state` behind), round 12 of card objectui#11070: the M3 re-run on the merged ref that the release record `6058770188` asked the next claimant to run first, then `sidebar.side` (pointer `5956633122`) declared on both faces — claim `6058868109`, dev report `6059807928` (`status: done`, one `open_questions` entry, two `out_of_scope_findings`). Inputs: the card body and its 66 comments, the handover `5934870641` among them; the PR body, its file list and the net diff against the merge base (read in the existing checkout from the head fetched into a ref of its own; `main` has since taken six commits, `7241a81e` through `e44f9bc4` — objectui#11865, #11933, #11908, #11894, #11924 and #11943, app-shell, plugin-list, auth and console work — none touching any of the PR's six paths, so the queue's rebuild carries no textual conflict); `@objectstack/spec` at its `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0` tag (`59026cea`) in the sibling checkout, which is the version `packages/types/package.json` depends on at the head (`^17.7.0`); and the 43 check-runs on the head, polled once a minute until none was in progress (final reading 2026-10-08T12:38Z, every run on `f835af41`): 40 success, 3 skipped by design (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)` and the coverage shard matrix), 0 failure — `Type Check`, `Lint`, the eight `Test` shards and the `Test` roll-up, `Test (dist pins)`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Doc Component Type Check`, `Doc Fence Language Check`, `Doc Example Id Check`, `Internal Docs Link Check`, `Docs Route Eager Closure Check`, `Build Docs`, `Build & E2E`, `Live E2E (informational)`, the five `Changeset` gates (`Bump Policy`, `Fixed Group Check`, `Declaration`, `Claim Re-read`, `Overwrite Report`), `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Pre-Install Import Graph Check`, `Bundle Analysis`, `README Export Check`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Shell Escape Residue Scan`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Skill Example Check`, `Skill Guide Path Check`, `Skill Eval Token Check`, `Action Ref Convention` and `label` among them. The gate verdicts are those conclusions; nothing was built, run or re-run here, and the dev's M3 figures, ablation rows and probe readings are quoted as the dev's, not re-derived. No earlier `## Contract review` names this head: the newest on the card (`5934528537`) names PR #11387's `cbc637c2`, and the PR thread carries one bot comment (the console performance budget), no record and 0 reviews.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface move the diff implies, each judged:

- **The strict face WIDENS on the `sidebar` arm by one key: `side`.** `SidebarSchema` (zod, `BaseSchema.extend`) gains `side: z.enum(['left', 'right'])`, `.optional()`, with a refusal message naming the two values. RIGHT — the declare route of the triage direction (`5888862869`: declare on both faces when authors write it and a renderer reads it), and exactly the key the pointer measured as refused (`5956633122`: `unrecognized_keys` on `{ type: 'sidebar', side: 'right' }` while the renderer draws the right edge). The read is real and was verified on the head tree: the `sidebar` registration's `inputs` carry `{ name: 'side', type: 'enum', enum: ['left', 'right'] }` and its `defaultProps` carry `side: 'left'`; `SidebarNode` destructures `{ schema, collapsible, ...props }` and spreads `{...props}` onto shadcn's `Sidebar`, whose own prop is typed `side?: "left" | "right"` with the default `"left"` (`packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx`, an upstream no-touch file, absent from the diff). The strict face is DERIVED — `strict-authoring-face.ts`'s walker closes each object through `catchall: z.never()` and walks the discriminated union's options — so the key enters it with no exemption list and no `.passthrough()` flip; `strict-authoring-face.ts` is absent from the diff. Pinned where it can fail: `it.each(['left', 'right'])` rows parse on the strict face and keep the value on the tolerant face while a misspelled sibling `sidee` is still refused by name; the new components pin reads the LIVE registration's `side` enum (`ComponentRegistry.getMeta('sidebar')`, the accessor objectui#11465's `variant` pin uses) and asks both faces about every value in it, so a registration that grows a value the schema does not take turns red. The dev's R0 (both files at the base under this head's pins: 8 vitest red, 3 `tsc` errors all in the pin) and A1 (the zod member deleted: 7 red, 2 `tsc`) are quoted as the dev's; the pins' shape shows they cannot pass without the declaration. True width: every `sidebar` node — the arm has no sub-type.
- **The tolerant face NARROWS on the same key's value: a `side` outside the two edges is refused where `BaseSchema`'s passthrough kept it unjudged.** `top` and a boolean are now `invalid_value` at `side` on `AnyComponentSchema` (what `safeValidateSchema` and `objectui validate` run) and on the strict face alike. RIGHT — the arithmetic consequence of typing a formerly passthrough key, the shape rounds 1, 3, 7, 10 and 11 priced on other faces; pinned by two `WRONG` rows on both faces and by the exact path-and-code row `[['side', 'invalid_value']]`; stated in the changeset under a BREAKING banner with the one-line fix ("Write `left` or `right`"). Corpus: no catalog `sidebar` document writes `side` at the head (the only catalog `"side"` writers are the two `components-overlay-sheet` documents, a different node) — the dev's M3 reads the same (five `sidebar` nodes at the base, none with `side`), taken as reported.
- **The TypeScript face: `SidebarSchema.side?: 'left' | 'right'`, flat and local.** RIGHT. `BaseSchema` declares no index signature (objectui#8347), so at the base a typed literal carrying `side` was refused as an excess property; now it compiles, `top` is a compile error (the `@ts-expect-error` row), and the type-level rows `assertionSidebarSideIsTheTwoEdges` hold BOTH faces to exactly `'left' | 'right' | undefined` through `z.input` of the zod member's shape, so a value widened or narrowed on either face fails to compile. The dev's A2 (the TS member deleted: 0 vitest red, 4 `tsc` errors — two in the pin, two in `zod-mirror-parity`'s `assertionMirroredUndeclared*` rows) is quoted as the dev's and is the expected shape of a one-face deletion under that ledger.
- **A LOCAL declaration is right here, because the spec has no row to reference — measured at the tag, not inherited from the dev.** At `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`, `ComponentPropsMap` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` carries `'page:sidebar': PageContainerProps` — the page region, a `strictObject` whose `surface` reads "this container component (`page:section` / `page:footer` / `page:sidebar`)" and which declares `children` — and carries no `'sidebar'` row; no export under `packages/spec/src/ui` declares a sidebar `side` (the only `side:` keys there are chart alias tables). objectui's own `page:sidebar` mirror (`public-blocks.zod.ts#PageSidebarBlockSchema`, spec-owned by reference) is that other node and is untouched. So "declare by reference" has nothing to reference, and the flat local route is the one rounds 7 (`columns`) and 10 (the grid keys) took when the spec declared nothing; the TS docblock points at the instrument that re-derives the spec entry (`check:component-surface-parity --type ui:sidebar`, a flag the script's usage line carries) rather than restating it. Consistent with the host-composition ruling (objectui#5097): `side` is an author-written key — a registration input the docs teach — not a host-supplied React prop.
- **The two-value enum matches what the renderer honours.** RIGHT: shadcn's prop type is exactly `"left" | "right"`, the registration's enum is exactly those two, and there is no third value to leave out, so the claim's spec-change stop condition had nothing to fire on. The render half is pinned through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry: on the collapsible form `right` draws `data-side="right"` with the panel at `right-0`, `left` is byte-equal to the absent key, every offered value draws differently; with `collapsible: false` (shadcn's `collapsible="none"` branch, the in-flow column) every value is byte-equal to absent — which is what both docblocks and the docs say ("shows on the collapsible form only, as `variant` does"). The dev's built-dist probe (left / right ACCEPT on both faces, `top` refused at `side` on both) agrees with the pins; quoted as the dev's.
- **The retired `position` key stays retired, and its refusal now points at `side`.** RIGHT on both faces: `position?: never` and `retiredSidebarKey('position', …)` are unchanged in kind; only the "Instead:" text grows "To draw the sidebar against the right edge, write `side: 'right'`". Pinned: `{ type: 'sidebar', position: 'right' }` is still `invalid_type` at `position` on both faces, and the mirror's own message is pinned to contain "side: 'right'". objectui#11465 deliberately did not point there while `side` was undeclared (`5956633122` records that); with `side` declared the pointer is true.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/components/basic/sidebar.mdx` gains "The `side` key" (what each edge draws; the narrow-viewport sheet side; the collapsible-only clause) with a JSON fence the dev's `check:doc-snippets` judged on both faces, and the "renderer reads" sentence now names `side` and `variant` beside `className` — true of `SidebarNode`'s spread. RIGHT. The TS "Schema" block does not show `side`; not owed, named under the reviewer's flags.
- **Parity ledgers — nothing was owed, and nothing moved.** The claim's file surface named "the registry or parity rows that record `ui:sidebar.side`": no such row exists — a grep at the head over `scripts`, `apps` and `packages` outside the touched files finds no ledger recording `ui:sidebar.side` or `sidebar.side`, and the registration already offered `side`. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` registers `navigation.zod.ts#SidebarSchema` against `Ts_SidebarSchema`; both faces now carry `side`, so no `UnmirroredDeclared` / `MirroredUndeclared` row moves (the dev's A1 and A2 show the ledger reds on a one-face deletion, as it should). `check:component-surface-parity` is REPORT-ONLY by ruling — its header: "Exit: 0 -- ALWAYS, disagreements included", quoting 「report-only 起步,零分歧后翻阻断」 — so the H2 reading (below, ③) is a count on a report, not a gate.
- **Changeset — one new entry, no dated notes.** RIGHT; priced in ②. `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` are green on the head, and the dev's `check:changeset-claims` read no pending changeset naming a touched file.
- **Exclusions held.** No `strict-authoring-face.ts`; no `objectql.ts` / `zod/objectql.zod.ts` (objectui#6152 round 8's surface); no `packages/components/src/ui/**` (the no-touch zone); no renderer source (`renderers/navigation/sidebar.tsx` is unchanged — the node never named `side` and still does not); no `package.json`; no governed path among the six (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` green; the dev's `check-governed-queue-guard --test` read NOT GOVERNED); 247 changed lines.
- **Head = the reviewed head.** `f835af41`'s one parent is the merge base `70e3d772`; the commit is the dev's and carries the model-free trailer pair (`Claude-Session` / `Co-authored-by: Claude`); every check-run ran on it; the net diff's file set and line counts (6 files, +235/−12) equal the PR's; the PR body opens "Part of #11070 (round 12)" (no closing keyword anywhere near a card number; 0 angle brackets), ends with the session-URL footer the PR-body channel keeps, and carries only labeler.yml's four labels (`documentation`, `package: types`, `package: components`, `tests`).

### ② Semver level

- The PR body's second line reads `Clause-②: yes` followed by em-dash prose naming both effects (widens: the strict face accepts `sidebar.side`; narrows: the tolerant face refuses a `side` outside the two values) and matches the claim `6058868109` (`Clause-②: yes` — "declaring `side` widens what the strict authoring face accepts"). The changeset's own bolded line reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and names the narrowing in the same sentence. Judged against what the diff publishes: the strict accept set of a published export (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`'s `sidebar` arm, and `SidebarSchema` from `@object-ui/types/zod`) widens by one key; the tolerant face narrows on that key's value; the TypeScript face narrows for a `top` literal. The `(widening)` arm is the reading rounds 10 and 11 recorded for this mixed shape on this card (`5932079845`, `5934528537`: the widening IS the published strict-face move, and the break rides the entry under its BREAKING heading) — RIGHT by that precedent, and `yes` takes at least minor. Named without changing the verdict: the fleet's one reader of the line, `clause2-line.mjs`, spells a diff that widens one surface and narrows another as `yes (narrowing)` ("both facts are true and both are read") and reads `yes (widening)` as "the first, said out loud" — true here, but the lesser of the two spellings; no objectui gate reads the arm (`check-adr-0087-registration` is objectstack's), and the BREAKING banner is typed, so nothing is unpriced. Whether the dev flips the arm before landing is the seat's call.
- `.changeset/11070-sidebar-side.md`: `@object-ui/types` **minor**. MATCHES what the diff publishes. `types` is the one released package whose source moves (`navigation.ts`, `zod/navigation.zod.ts`); `@object-ui/components` carries a new test file only, which rides the fixed group with no bump of its own, as rounds 4, 6, 7, 10 and 11 read test-only edits; `content/docs` is not a released package.
